subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Boundary Lubrication: The Danger Zone
description: One-minute skill: Boundary Lubrication: The Danger Zone.

hook.text: Sometimes the oil film is too thin. Metal peaks poke through and touch.

buildup.text: At low speed or high load, the full fluid film can't form.

discovery.text: Oil additives bond to the metal, creating a thin protective layer.

twist.text: That layer is only molecules thick yet prevents metal seizure.

climax.text: Engine startups are in boundary mode. Good oil chemistry saves parts.

punchline.text: A few molecules stand between running and ruin.

quiz.question: What protects surfaces during boundary lubrication?
options: The bulk oil film between the surfaces
Chemical additives that bond to metal and form a thin layer
